starter_questions: Move the simulated robot to Zone A.
What is the robot's current status?
What should I expect from the warehouse simulation?
Did the last move arrive, and what evidence confirms it?
Remember that loading dock means Zone A.

setup_guide.introduction: I'll guide the simulated warehouse robot between approved Zones A, B and C and report observed progress. Start the included warehouse simulation on a compatible NVIDIA node, then ask for its status. You can request a move or Stop once ready; this controls a simulation only.

sample.title: Warehouse robot simulation
sample.description: Start the included TurtleBot warehouse world with its default headless settings. A compatible NVIDIA Docker Compose node is required.
sample.expected_output: Once the warehouse simulation is ready, a live dashboard and Chat controls for Zones A, B and C, current status and Stop.

fields.label: Simulation scenario
fields.description: The bundled warehouse world is the supported scenario.
